When the application ends while the program runs, nothing signals the program: pkexec's parent-death signal is cleared when it switches to root. Standard input reaches its end instead (see

), and nothing reads standard output and error any more: .NET's console drops writes silently, while the tools the program starts get write errors (EPIPE) or, when they handle SIGPIPE by default, are killed.
